conflict.summary: 24 requirements ask this key: 23 at greaterThanOrEqual "98", which no boolean vendor can meet (int(float(True)) is 1), and 1 at isEquals true, which no percentage vendor can meet. There is no customer for whom both readings work. Roughly half the estate's endpoint customers get a wrong answer on the most-asked endpoint criterion.

positions.meaning: Whole-number percentage of onboarded endpoints whose protection agent reports a healthy, correctly configured state (each vendor defines healthy and the staleness window differently).

proposedResolution.summary: Split, per F-KEY-06: the percentage moves to a new key that carries the 98% bar under atLeast; isEPPConfigured stays a boolean only if some vendor genuinely has no denominator to report. Additive first (decision Q6): emit the new key alongside, shadow-diff, re-point the 23 requirements, then deprecate.
